description: This file is a shell script for testing and diagnosing network connectivity issues. It includes functionalities such as rebooting the router, performing ping and DNS ping tests, and taking corrective actions based on the test outcomes.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Fetches the state of the corrective action setting from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random sleep interval to stagger ping attempts, using awk and date for seeding.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by invoking dmcli simulation command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Determines if a reset is needed based on process name and triggers router reset.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS resolution test for a URL fetched from system configuration and takes corrective action if needed.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs network ping tests to the default gateway and based on results, takes corrective actions.
